summary: BR Brain · Smart Paste, verification codes and private adaptation

changes.title: Destination-aware Smart Paste
changes.detail: Unique compatible entity selection, copy freshness and cached typing intent; ordinary paste remains original.

changes.title: Verification-code and Autofill compatibility
changes.detail: Recognized OTP fields can offer a masked manually copied code; Android provider suggestions keep exclusive priority.

changes.title: Private adaptation and motion
changes.detail: Encrypted category-only feedback with reset control and short capsule-fill transitions; no network or new permissions.
